text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I've finished filling it out.

text_block_list.name: Hospital Receptionist
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. The visiting hours 
are written on this card.

text_block_list.name: Hospital Receptionist
text_block_list.text:
Please vacate the premises prior to the 
designated time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, are you still resting? Teacher.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The weather sure is nice today. The sun 
still has the gentle face of spring.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Sensei.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There is one choice I'd like to make. 
...Will you forgive this selfishness of 
mine?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale... Whew...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
“—Round 4 of the 'National Representative 
Exchange Matches' is coming up soon. 
Japan's representatives for this year will 
likely be announced after that.”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"To win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe... 
I'll have to crush every single one of 
those girls trying to carry Japan on their 
shoulders."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —The prime favorite is definitely her.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... It really is a gamble...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Kindle their fighting spirits. And on 
top of that, I will—

While heading to the training grounds with 
<chrname>, someone tapped me on the back twice.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Wait a second.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>. I've got a bit of mundane 
business with you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...There is no way we're handing over the 
spot of representing Japan this year to 
you guys."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Time is always running short.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, I want to turn that place 
into the scenery of dreams. The place she 
loved so dearly."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Fight with everything you have. Try and 
defeat me with all your might."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—In the upcoming 'Representative Exchange 
Match'.
